fixtures.name: main
fixtures.copy:
COPY (SELECT
        (i - 2000)::INTEGER AS id,
        (CASE WHEN i % 11 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (i - 2000) * 1.5 END)::DOUBLE AS amt,
        CAST(i AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS price,
        (CASE WHEN i % 13 = 0 THEN '' ELSE 'n' || i END) AS name,
        (CASE WHEN i % 7 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE 'v' || i END) AS nname,
        (DATE '2020-01-01' + i::INTEGER) AS d,
        (CASE WHEN i % 5 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (i % 3 = 0) END) AS flag,
        (CASE WHEN i % 17 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01' + to_milliseconds(i) END)::TIMESTAMP_MS AS ts
      FROM range(1, 4000) t(i)) TO '{path}' (FORMAT PARQUET, ROW_GROUP_SIZE 500)

fixtures.name: having
fixtures.copy:
COPY (SELECT floor(sqrt(i))::INTEGER AS g, (i % 3)::INTEGER AS h, i::BIGINT AS v,
        (CASE WHEN i % 11 = 0 OR floor(sqrt(i)) = 7 THEN NULL ELSE i * 1.5 END)::DOUBLE AS x,
        CAST(i AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS p, ('s' || (i % 17)) AS s
      FROM range(0, 1000000) t(i)) TO '{path}' (FORMAT PARQUET, ROW_GROUP_SIZE 65536)

fixtures.name: tie_a
fixtures.copy:
COPY (SELECT i AS id, (CASE WHEN i % 997 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE 3 - i // 1500 END)::BIGINT AS k,
            (i * 7919) % 101 AS v, 'a' AS src FROM range(0, 6000) t(i))
            TO '{path}' (FORMAT PARQUET, ROW_GROUP_SIZE 2048)

fixtures.name: tie_b
fixtures.copy:
COPY (SELECT i AS id, (CASE WHEN i % 997 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE i // 1500 END)::BIGINT AS k,
            (i * 7919) % 101 AS v, 'b' AS src FROM range(0, 6000) t(i))
            TO '{path}' (FORMAT PARQUET, ROW_GROUP_SIZE 2048)
